title: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol Header Verifier
description: Verifies Visa Trusted Agent Protocol (TAP) HTTP Message Signature headers against a fixed 9-point checklist: header format, component coverage, RFC 9421 signature-base reconstruction, algorithm allowlist, optional WebCrypto signature verification, created/expires freshness, and nonce/tag checks. Never fetches a key over the network; verification runs only against a pasted public key.

request_line.description: Optional request line, e.g. GET https://merchant.example/checkout

public_key.description: Optional Ed25519 base64 key, RSA-PSS PEM key, or Agent Registry /keys/{key_id} JSON record

mcp_tool_definition.name: verify_visa_tap_header
mcp_tool_definition.description: Run the 9-point TAP header verification checklist against pasted Signature-Input/Signature headers, with optional real signature verification against a pasted public key.

public_key.description: Optional public key or registry record
